headline: Names a Postal Service building in Findlay, Ohio, after Michael Garver Oxley.
what_it_does: This law renames the United States Postal Service facility at 229 West Main Cross Street in Findlay, Ohio, as the "Michael Garver Oxley Memorial Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves. The summary provided does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the naming took effect on that date.
